notes.title: First Game Update
notes.content:
Battle for Fort Donelson. Update 1.

Dear players,
This update concerns a number of internal mechanisms and gameplay elements (thanks to players and Moon Shadow in particular for their feedback). 

The engine and the game itself have been updated to resolve a number of residual bugs. 

Essentially:

[olist]
 The calendar should now work correctly and no longer switch from one day to the next too quickly.

 The supply/command lines (communication lines) sometimes worked incorrectly, not extending up to three zones between each relay. This has now been fixed.

 The mortality rate among the leaders seemed abnormally high. In fact, one modifier worked in the opposite way to what was expected. The new settings should make the ‘chances’ of leaders being hit in combat more realistic and reasonable. Beware, however, that this is the Civil War and senior officers remain vulnerable, with every engagement representing a risk (in reality, several were killed or wounded during the battle).

 US Landing companies transport by river should now work properly 

[/olist]

notes.title: Release of SGS Battle for Fort Donelson
notes.content:
SGS Battle for Fort Donelson

The assault of Confederate Fort Donelson by Union forces under Ulysses S. Grant in February 1862 marks a key moment and real turning point in the US Civil War.  

The fifth game of the SGS Battle Series is available, allowing you to fight the struggle to gain control of the fortifications that are the key of control of the Cumberland river. Their capture would allow the Union to forage deeper into Confederate territory. After the epic battles for Stalingrad, Madrid, Hué and Shanghai, we are now in 19th century North America.

Take command of the Union Forces gathered by U.S.Grant attacking the enemy fortifications overlooking the Cumberland river, or play the Confederate forces that have to defend that key position protecting their rear areas from future enemy landings.

SGS Battle Series is an evolution and adaptation of the renown SGS engine to operational or grand tactical combats and this 5th release also enjoys a brand new UI design.

Please also check our Dev blog here https://strategygamestudio.com/dev-blog/ for more news about this title and our other games.
